text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bring Nishino Flower to a lush, green
park as a
way to thank her for always
helping me recharge
when I'm feeling
weary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow! The scent of the trees and flowers
is
wonderful... Hehe, this place is so
refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for bringing me,
Trainer! I
love it here, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
These are all things only I like... Aren't
you
bored?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of the relaxation
techniques
she's shown me so far has
worked wonders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So anything that provides her comfort
will surely
make me feel the same way
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her to take it easy and relax to her
heart's
content.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll do just that and have a nice,
easygoing
day!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look at all the pretty fish over
there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the murmur of a stream while
surrounded
by all this verdant flora is
simply wonderful! Wow,
the river from
before looks so tiny—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-whoa! I had no idea this
suspension bridge
was so high up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
U-um... Trainer? Can you... hold my
hand? Just
until we get to the other
side...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Phweee!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! A leaf whistle. It's been forever
since I
made one, so I'm a little out of
practice.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course! First, you have to find a long,
narrow
leaf. Then, put the end to your
lips like this and...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the plum kelp tea. It
really hits the
spot when you're tired,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It sure is! And spending time like this is
so...
choice_data_list: That stuff really works wonders, doesn't it~
That stuff really works wonders, doesn't it~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, nothing. It's almost time to leave,
isn't it?
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. I had a
great time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy... and I feel so blessed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you remember how I said I like
taking it
easy?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I love being completely at peace and
not having
a care in the world.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It makes me feel so warm and fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined that I'd get to
experience that
lovely feeling again with
someone, since I can't
meet up with my
older neighbors so easily
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Every second we spent today was
amazing. I can't
put words to how happy
I was.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yay, let's do it!
choice_data_list: I'm happy to join you anytime for something like this.
Next time, wanna try just taking it easy?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But after spending so much time
relaxing, I'll have
to really put in work
for my next race!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got it. If I perform well in my
race, why
don't we come back here to
celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I'll need to give it my all!
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to achieve victory and then relax
with you
again!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow... What a line. You sure are mature,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! You always seem so in
control, and I
feel like I can always rely
on you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I need to become a grown-up
Umamusume who's
worthy of standing by
your side...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll strive to follow your example,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I resolve to always conduct myself as an

upstanding adult should, for her sake as
much as
my own.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! We'll need some
desserts to
go along with our tea, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've got some red bean jelly that would
be just
perfect. Leave everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, I share a relaxing
teatime with
an enthusiastic Nishino
Flower. I could definitely
get used to
afternoons like this.
